title: They were told to kill each other… so they played football instead ⚽
caption:
They were told to kill each other… so they played football instead ⚽ Christmas Day 1914, the Christmas truce football. A true story.

Who would you pass the ball to this Christmas? Tell us in the comments 👇

A ball that goes across and comes back is a question and its answer.

"The First to Stand Up" – the whole true story as a book.
🇩🇪 Auch auf Deutsch: „Wer zuerst aufsteht“
🇫🇷 Aussi en français : « Le Premier à se lever »

slides.text: They were enemies. Then someone kicked a ball.
A British soldier kicked a football over to the German wire.
Someone over there trapped it… and kicked it back.
Soon: heavy boots, greatcoats, one ball. "No referee and no score."
A ball that goes across and comes back is a question and its answer.
Who would you pass the ball to this Christmas?

firstComment: Be honest: would you have kicked it back? 👀
